rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a person or thing is prepared and can be used or acted on immediately.

example.english: I'm ready, so we can set off.
example.traditional: 我準備好喇，可以出發喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeon2 bei6 hou2 laa3 ho2 ji5 ceot1 faat3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for something ready-made or already prepared, especially when contrasting it with something that must be made.

example.english: These biscuits are ready to eat, so there's no need to make them ourselves.
example.traditional: 呢啲餅係現成嘅，唔使自己整。
example.jyutping: nei1 di1 beng2 hai6 jin6 sing4 ge3 m4 sai2 zi6 gei2 zing2
